NBPTS confirms the claim: the certification process collects standards-based evidence of accomplished practice (student work samples, video, teaching exhibits) scored against the Five Core Propositions and the Architecture of Accomplished Teaching, i.e. artifact-anchored, not reflection-only, evidence. Add a currency caveat on edTPA: governance now sits with ETS, and the assessment is no longer universally mandated. So if edTPA is named, frame it as 'where adopted' rather than as a current universal gate; NBPTS is the safer, still-current anchor for a blind artifact-scored portfolio.
